# invertPaintTransform

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The inverse, or `null` when the transform is not invertible.

Needed to map a painted region back into paint space - a translucent gradient's soft-mask form has its `/BBox` in paint space once a transform exists.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
invertPaintTransform(transform: PaintTransform): PaintTransform | null
```
